source_verified_facts: getInstance/close synchronize singleton ownership, not all DAO use
player destroy and playlist onDestroy may initiate writes
feed cancel flag is not a SQL drain acknowledgement
WorkManager initializer and side processes are in merged manifest
checkpoint cursor lacks explicit close in the observed method
not_proven: retained Room DAO behavior after close
preferred_next_design_proof: Cold-process maintenance mode with startup/factory fencing; conditional, not an implementation approval
alternatives: Same main process cold restart into maintenance
